description: Native Markdown editor with block-level live preview
notes: Settings are stored in %APPDATA%\Paperly\settings.json (theme, language, sidebar, search color, last folder); Scoop cannot persist this path.
This is the portable build: it does not register a permanent .md file association. Use 'Open with' to point .md files at paperly.exe, or run 'paperly note.md' from the command line.
